item.title: BRICS Media Coverage Explained: What Western Narratives Miss
item.description: BRICS media coverage often misrepresents the eleven-country alliance. Learn how Western narratives overlook BRICS’ diversity, and growing global influence.

item.title: BRICS 2025 Summit: Change, De-dollarization, and Shifting Global Power
item.description: The BRICS 2025 summit highlights change in global power. From de-dollarization to challenging the G7, BRICS is shaping multipolar governance and a new global order.

item.title: BRICS Trade Wars: De-dollarization, New Alliances, and Global Shifts
item.description: Discover how BRICS trade wars in 2025 are reshaping the global economy. From de-dollarization to green energy, see how BRICS is countering US tariffs and promoting a multipolar world.

item.title: BRICS Africa Trade: How BRICS+ Puts Africa at the Center of Global Commerce
item.description: Discover how BRICS Africa trade is reshaping global commerce. From resource wealth to the New Development Bank, see why Africa is central to BRICS+ strategy and the future world economy.

item.title: BRICS Youth Voices: How the Next Generation Shapes Multipolarity
item.description: Discover BRICS youth voices on multipolarity. From education and digital innovation to climate action, the next generation is shaping BRICS and the future global order.
